text:
maria.p: Heads-up: we're seeing repeated tokens in streaming responses from /v1/stream for hosted models in us-west2. Reports started ~10:05 PST. Non-stream (sync) calls look fine. Customers with chat UIs seeing verbatim repeats. Investigating. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3165432100

sre-raj: Confirmed in tracing — identical chunk payloads with same sequence id emitted twice during proxy handoff. Looks like an HTTP/2 retry + mux replay interaction.

alice.k: Repro locally when proxy resets connection and downstream retries before ACKing the second chunk. Adding eng-runtime and proxy owners.

sre-raj: Immediate mitigation: flip streaming retry to fail-fast on reset for us-west2 at the proxy layer, and temporarily disable multiplexed client retries. Rolling canary at 5%.

deploy-bot: deploy started: proxy-config/us-west2/retry-failfast canary=5% (tg: proxy-rolling).

sre-raj: Canary telemetry (5m): duplication rate dropped from ~2.3 -> ~1.1. Latency/p99 steady. Proceeding to 25% after checks.

alice.k: Adding a short-lived ingress dedupe in the mux: if same seq_id arrives within 8s, drop duplicate. Low-risk guard. Pushing patch to canary group.

sre-raj: 25% -> 50% -> 100% rollout over 20m. After 100%, duplication metric ~1.01 (within noise). No customer escalations after 12m.

ops-oncall: Public status note queued: "Investigating — some hosted streaming responses in us-west2 may show duplicated tokens. Workaround being rolled out; more updates to follow."

status-page-bot: Public incident posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3165432100 — banner sent to affected orgs.

maria.p: Triage owners: eng-runtime (alice.k) to own root cause and fix, eng-proxy (sre-raj) to own short-term mitigation, eng-sre (ops-oncall) for monitoring and customer comms.

alice.k: Short-term PR created to remove redundant replay path + unit tests for stream retry. Long-term: redesign handshake to surface ack before retrying chunks. Filing RFC.

sre-raj: Follow-up action items: 1) postmortem within 72h, 2) retro on retry semantics, 3) status update to customers in 30m.

maria.p: Thanks everyone. Keeping this open for 30 more minutes of quiet observations. If you see any regressions, @ops-oncall. :pray:
